title: Socialice
identity: Georgia Nicolaou, SocialICE (2016), for soprano singer and alto saxophone, Donemus D16595. The composer says it was written for SaraS duo and provides theatrical role/action notes. Donemus’s four-page public preview is explicitly a transposed score and contains three notation pages.

evidence.claim: Composer page identifies SocialICE (2016), soprano singer and alto saxophone, and the SaraS duo context; its composer note describes theatrical actions and social-media theme.
Donemus public preview cover identifies the soprano-singer/alto-saxophone instrumentation and states “Transposed score”; performance note describes the character roles and flexible staging/actions.

Visual inspection of notation shows the singer declaiming “Click/Chat/Snap/Post” text with theatrical dynamic and tempo markings, while the alto saxophone uses repeated percussive attacks and slap tongue, tuplets, and later rapid groupings of five, six, and seven notes; meter changes include 2/4, 3/4, and 4/4. This is a short score excerpt.

score_observations.observation: The transposed score gives the singer spoken and text-like “Click/Chat/Snap/Post” entries with abrupt dynamic changes. The alto saxophone has repeated slap-tongue/percussive attacks in q=84 rhythmic passages, then more sustained and rapid material; the inspected later page shows changing tuplets, including five-, six-, and seven-note groupings, across 2/4, 3/4, and 4/4. Full range is not assessed from the excerpt.

review_focus: Inference: assess coordination between the singer’s speech-like text and the saxophone’s rhythmic/percussive commentary, including fast subdivisions and changes of meter; confirm whether the staging actions suit the intended performance setting.
collection_flag: Original theatrical duet for soprano singer and alto saxophone, written for SaraS duo; no pedagogical audience claim is made.

listening.description: Composer page embeds SocialICE official video and credits soprano Sara Carolina Marques and alto saxophonist Sarah Wünsche.
listening.verification: Performance credits verified on opened composer page; playback not auditioned.

score_links.description: Four-page public preview; cover explicitly labels score transposed, and performance note plus notation pages visually inspected.

gaps: Preview shows selected pages only; complete written range and full work demands remain unknown.
No college or professional teaching placement verified.
